title: Playing with Joe Oliver and Kid Ory; Dodds and Wade
summary: Foster recalls playing in Ory's band with Oliver, Punch, Johnny Dodds and Happy, and who left and returned, until Ory went to California.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you ever play with Joe Oliver or any of those? Oh, yeah.
I played with Joe Oliver quite a while. In Ory's band. So in Kid Ory's band.
Yeah, Kid Ory's band. Okay. I know, as Ory told me once, he used to use Henry Martin on drums too some. On drums, yeah. But not all the time.
Yeah, I see, uh, in those times before his feet got bad. But then you had another fella named Happy. Oh, yes, that's right.
I've heard of him. Red Happy, huh? Red Happy.
I see, and then after, well, when Happy got together, well, it was hard to tell who was who. Some say I was the best, some say he was the best.
Was Wade unclarated at that time?
Wade, yeah, he was unclarated at that time.
Yeah. You remember when Johnny Dodds came in the band or did Punch play with Ory too, didn't he a while?
Yeah, Punch played with Ory a while before he went with Jack Kelly.
Mm-hmm. Yeah.
Then he sub the tooth a while after, you know, until he got a record.
You remember when Johnny Dodds was in Ory's band, did he play with same time you did or?
Yeah, same time I did. Same time I did.
Wade had gone when you were playing with him or was he, did he play with Wade too with that group?
No, Wade hadn't left. He left first.
Yeah. Yeah.
Then he came back. Joe Oliver left and he sent for Johnny Dodds. See? All right. That time, when Lewis was playing with Ory.
Oh, yeah.

And when he left Ory, he went out on the boat. Mm-hmm. That's why he learned to raise his music out on the boat. See? But that time, Wade had come back and started playing with Ory. Mm-hmm. Because Joe Oliver had left way a long time before, before Ory then. Yeah. After Ory went to California, well then they all hooked up together and made the band up over again after they got over there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's where Joe Oliver got the name of King Oliver after he got up there. But over here, this is called Joe Oliver. Yeah.
